meta.name: board
meta.description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取和发布 AgentHub 消息板上的协调消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要与其他 AgentHub 智能体交换协调信息
copy.tagline_en: Read and post coordination messages on the AgentHub message board
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to exchange coordination messages with other AgentHub agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取、发布和浏览 AgentHub 消息板上的帖子，用于智能体之间的协调。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /hub:board 命令，或要求发布、读取、查看协调消息时触发。

say.text: 在 progress 频道发布消息，作者为 agent-1，内容为“任务进行中”

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, write, and browse posts on the AgentHub message board for agent coordination.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages.

say_en.note: Shows channels like dispatch, progress, results.
Displays all posts in that channel.

say_en.text: Post to progress channel, author agent-1, message "Task in progress"
